digest.component_or_area: dependency management / CI gating / pip-audit security check
propositions: pip-audit gate fails on every Gerrit patchset with click 8.2.1 PYSEC-2026-2132 (command injection in click.edit), blocking Verified +1 votes
click 8.2.1 is pinned in uv.lock as a transitive dependency via inspect-ai, which caps click to versions below 8.2.2 across all inspect-ai releases through 0.3.251
uv resolves all extras jointly, so click cannot be upgraded to 8.3.3+ without either removing inspect-ai or using override-dependencies to replace its constraint
override-dependencies = ["click>=8.3.3"] in pyproject.toml allows click to upgrade to 8.4.2 without affecting downstream consumers or CI test coverage
click 8.4.2 is compatible with inspect-ai 0.3.251 (verified: imports cleanly and CLI subcommands render/exit successfully), proving the upstream cap is stale
